description: This file is a PHP script that sets up and runs a console application for the OrangeHRM system's developer tools. It loads dependencies, registers commands related to data management, database migration, and documentation generation, then executes the console application.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Symphony Console Application used to add and run console commands for the OrangeHRM devTools.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new console application instance.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Registers a new command with the console application.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the console application, processing command-line input.
